reviewer: Implementation agent self-review; not independent review
scope: Separate workspace presentation and learning records, and consolidate the existing design theme

boundaries.app.ts: Owns the current model, history, selection, pointer interaction, and canvas drawing
boundaries.inspector.ts: Renders object and joint properties from an explicit model snapshot; edits use the existing commit callback
boundaries.responses.ts: Presents the selected section, support reactions, stability, and response explanations
boundaries.workspace-controls.ts: Binds tool, response, and mode choices with accessible pressed state and shared course symbol geometry
boundaries.learning-session.ts: Owns verifier configuration, pseudonymous attempt queue, connection checks, and insights
boundaries.worked.ts: Existing solution renderer retains its model, section, request, and reveal interface
boundaries.theme.css: Owns font faces and shared colour, font, spacing, focus, and radius variables

behaviour_review.preserved: Solver, proof sources, scientific conventions, load metadata, API endpoints, record fields, browser storage keys, and undo checkpoint ownership
behaviour_review.corrections: Removed a duplicate return introduced during extraction. Expanded connection and recording code into readable steps. Attempt fields remain explicit and the model is cloned before awaiting a request.
behaviour_review.automated: Type checking and all 38 Node tests passed. New tests exercise offline snapshot retention, asynchronous record isolation, and credential exclusion from recorded attempts.
behaviour_review.browser: Verified load editing (29 kN gives 58 kN m at midspan), undo/redo, response-layer selection, published symbolic solutions and KaTeX rendering, an offline submission and its insights row, and a rotational-spring constraint edit followed by undo restoring 10000 kN m/rad.
behaviour_review.visual: Compared computed styles and dimensions for 24 workspace selectors at 1440 x 1000 and 390 x 844 against the baseline. No differences were found. Inspected both viewport screenshots.
behaviour_review.data: Browser checks used synthetic examples on a separate static-preview origin. No private pilot database was changed. Local Lean execution remained disabled.

readability_review: Checked module inputs and callbacks against engine.ts, worked.ts, and existing tests. Kept dependencies explicit, consolidated escaping/number formatting/download helpers, and formatted the stylesheets. Removed 162 declarations superseded later in the same cascade without reordering retained rules.
scope_limit: No course curriculum was migrated and no new framework was installed. The proposed Learn area and Astro content layer remain a teaching-platform recommendation.
